# pixelfx core (vendored)

`src/core` of [patch-gg/pixelfx](https://github.com/patch-gg/pixelfx) at commit fe7103c, MIT License
(see LICENSE). `sim.js` adapts Sprite Fusion's open-source pixel art VFX
(https://www.spritefusion.com/pixel-art-vfx), Copyright (c) 2026 Hugo Duprez, MIT License.

Copied unchanged so upstream fixes can be diffed in. Our effects live in `src/fx/` and are played by
`src/game/pfx.ts`; see docs/FX.md.
